summary: Scoped managed-game handoffs implemented. Verify current-head Rust exporter, frontend, Godot and installed export checks before acceptance. Do not redo completed Armor or BUILD-1.

delivery.scope: Windows compile, Godot E2E, production safety suites, installer, native installed frontend/bundled runtime, reinstall/uninstall canary, artifact upload and independently downloaded bytes.

limits: New exporter code is not in the earlier BUILD-1 installer. Current-head native artifact is separately required.
Filename exclusions are not a content secret scanner. Export guards are not a hostile-code sandbox.
Existing games without game_context.json use labeled read-only routes; export does not write a migration.
Game source remains a bootstrap; planned UI/map/simulation modules are reading routes, not implemented mechanics.
handoff: Read AGENTS.md, this checkpoint and packages card at current HEAD. Check PACK-1 PR/Actions. Tests are in core/context/tests.rs and tools/context-ui.test.cjs; installed probe verifies actual scoped archive payloads. Keep Bridge and game memories separate.
